title: BME (CDRI-08) mitigates hypoxia-induced hippocampal neurodegeneration and memory impairment via modulating NMDAR-CREB-BDNF signaling and apoptosis reduction
task: Mitigate hypoxia-induced hippocampal neurodegeneration and memory impairment
key_results: BME restored NR2A/NR2B expression, reversed CREB-BDNF suppression, increased pyramidal neuron spine density, and reduced cleaved caspase-3 and pro-apoptotic proteins (BAD, BAX) while elevating Bcl-2
comments: The study demonstrates multi-target engagement but lacks quantitative metrics for spine density changes and memory improvement magnitudes, and the CoCl2 model may not fully recapitulate physiological hypoxia.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Extra-synaptic NMDAR activation and NR2B upregulation drive apoptotic cascades in hypoxia
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BME restored NR2A/NR2B balance and suppressed apoptotic signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: CREB-BDNF pathway suppression mediates hypoxia-induced memory deficits
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BME reversed CREB-BDNF suppression and restored memory function

hypotheses.hypothesis: BME reduces neuronal apoptosis by modulating pro- and anti-apoptotic protein expression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decreased caspase-3, BAD, BAX and increased Bcl-2

title: Hierarchical grouped convolution and multi-scale vision transformer for uncertainty-aware early breast cancer detection using mammography
task: Uncertainty-aware breast cancer classification from mammography
key_results: 98.67% accuracy, 0.9914 AUC, 14.35% improvement over baseline ViT (84.32%)
comments: Strong clinical applicability through calibrated uncertainty quantification, though evaluation limited to single dataset (CBIS-DDSM); Monte Carlo Dropout provides interpretable confidence measures.

model_io.model: HGCViT-UAC (Hierarchical Grouped Convolution + Multi-Scale Vision Transformer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale hierarchical feature learning with adaptive fusion improves classification over single-scale ViT
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 14.35% accuracy improvement with uncertainty quantification

title: A hybrid 3D-CNN and CGAN approach for bipolar disorder diagnosis using VBM and SBC features from multimodal MRI
task: Bipolar disorder diagnosis from multimodal MRI using VBM and functional connectivity
key_results: 93.49% mean accuracy and 0.97 AUC; independent test set 93.02% accuracy with 83.33% sensitivity and 96.77% specificity; CGAN augmentation improved accuracy by 3.02%
comments: Small sample size (170 total subjects) limits generalizability; biologically grounded feature extraction (VBM and seed-based connectivity) is methodologically sound but requires multi-site validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal integration of sMRI and fMRI features outperforms single-modality approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 93.49% multimodal vs 81.39% sMRI-only and 88.37% fMRI-only

hypotheses.hypothesis: CGAN-based feature-space augmentation improves model robustness

title: Analysis of metaheuristic‑optimized ann for predicting surface strip footing bearing capacity in layered cohesionless soils using limit equilibrium analysis
task: Shallow-foundation bearing capacity prediction in layered cohesionless soils
key_results: BBO-MLP achieved test correlation 0.9834, SD ratio 1.002, centered RMSE 130.19 kPa; footing width identified as dominant predictor via SHAP
comments: Comprehensive metaheuristic comparison with rigorous validation/test splitting and stability assessment; SHAP interpretability adds practical value.

model_io.model: Four hybrid MLP variants (BBO-MLP, LCA-MLP, SFO-MLP, WOA-MLP)
inputs: footing width, upper-layer thickness, upper-layer friction angle, lower-layer friction angle

hypotheses.hypothesis: BBO-optimized MLP provides superior generalization for nonlinear layer-interaction effects
hypotheses.result: BBO-MLP test correlation 0.9834 with stable convergence behavior

title: Application of artificial neural networks for prediction modeling and analysis of the thermophysical properties of Fe₃O₄/water ferrofluid using experimental measurement
task: Prediction of thermophysical properties of Fe₃O₄/water ferrofluid via artificial neural networks
key_results: ANN correlation coefficient 0.98 for thermal conductivity; dynamic viscosity increases from 0 to 0.77 cP as volume fraction rises 0.05%–4.0%
comments: Standard ANN approach with reasonable predictive performance; lacks details on network architecture, training procedure, and comparison with alternative machine learning methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ANN models accurately predict thermal conductivity and viscosity dependence on nanoparticle concentration and temperature
hypotheses.result: Thermal conductivity correlation 0.98; viscosity behavior consistent with expected particle-interaction physics

title: Incorporating hydrometeorological drivers into regime-switching volatility framework for water-level prediction
task: Water-level forecasting with regime-switching volatility and hydrometeorological drivers
key_results: MS-gjr-GARCH model achieved best performance for heavy-tailed fluctuations; structural breakpoints significantly influence volatility; rainfall and API influence conditional mean
comments: Well-motivated hybrid ARIMAX-MS-GARCH framework with breakpoint detection adds rigor; though specific accuracy metrics and comparison baselines are not fully detailed.

model_io.model: ARIMAX-Markov Switching GARCH (sGARCH, eGARCH, gjr-GARCH variants)
inputs: water-level time series, rainfall, API (antecedent precipitation index), breakpoint timestamps
outputs: probabilistic water-level forecasts with regime-dependent volatility

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural breaks and exogenous hydrometeorological drivers influence water-level volatility and conditional mean dynamics
hypotheses.result: MS-gjr-GARCH best captured regime-dependent variability; rainfall/API significant in conditional mean

title: Robust hybrid internal model control based smith predictor for MIMO systems with multiple time delays
task: Robust control of MIMO systems with multiple time delays using IMC-based Smith predictor
key_results: Linear MIMO: 57% settling-time reduction, 97% overshoot decrease, 58% error reduction versus conventional IMC; nonlinear MIMO: 64% settling-time and 70% tracking-error reduction versus decentralized PI; robustness maintained under ±50% delay uncertainty
comments: Comprehensive linear-to-nonlinear extension with rigorous robustness testing; practical gains are substantial, though nonlinear model validation on experimental processes would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: IMC-SP (linear MIMO) and IMMC-SP (nonlinear MIMO via local linear models with switching)
inputs: MIMO system state, setpoint, model parameters, time delays

hypotheses.hypothesis: IMC-Smith Predictor structure reduces settling time and overshoot in linear MIMO with multiple delays
hypotheses.result: 57% settling reduction, 97% overshoot decrease versus conventional IMC

hypotheses.hypothesis: Extension to nonlinear MIMO via local linear models maintains performance gains under model uncertainty
hypotheses.result: 64% settling reduction, 70% error reduction versus decentralized PI; stable under ±50% delay variation

title: Shear capacity of tapered web panel of plate girders with web opening
task: Shear capacity prediction for tapered plate girders with web openings
key_results: 115 FE models validated against 7 tested girders; EC3-aligned mechanics-based capacity equation developed via nonlinear regression; tapering angle improves shear capacity; capacity decreases with opening ratio, panel aspect ratio, web slenderness
comments: Rigorous experimental-simulation-design integration with parametric sensitivity study; equation provides direct prediction without iterative FE solving, valuable for practitioners.

model_io.model: Shell finite-element analysis (FE) + nonlinear regression capacity model
inputs: web slenderness ratio, opening ratio, panel aspect ratio, tapering angle

hypotheses.hypothesis: A mechanics-based capacity equation incorporating web slenderness, opening ratio, panel aspect ratio, and tapering angle accurately predicts shear capacity
hypotheses.result: FE-validated equation shows consistent agreement with parametric dataset

title: Hybrid classifier for water quality classification from satellite image trained with modified multi texton features
task: Water quality classification from satellite imagery using hybrid classifiers and multi-texton features
key_results: ECA-MSNet + LeNet hybrid achieved 96.385% sensitivity at TD=90%; outperformed individual baselines (Bi-GRU, Dense-net, Link-net, Shuffle-net, SVM+RF+MLR)
comments: Feature fusion strategy combining data and image modalities is sound, but evaluation metrics are incomplete (only sensitivity reported) and dataset details are sparse.

inputs: preprocessed Baitarani/Brahmani river satellite images; raw, entropy, VI-based, deep, and modified MT features

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid ensemble of ECA-MSNet and LeNet with fused data-image features improves water quality classification
hypotheses.result: Achieved 96.385% sensitivity; outperformed individual and other ensemble baselines

title: Analytical solution to the Kronig–Penney model with harmonic oscillator wells: insights to tight-binding
task: Analytical solution to Kronig–Penney model with harmonic oscillator wells
key_results: Derived closed-form energy dispersion and wave functions; expressed tight-binding tunneling amplitude in terms of harmonic oscillator potential parameters
comments: Theoretical refinement replacing square wells with truncated harmonic oscillators is physically more realistic and yields explicit tight-binding expressions; limited practical impact without numerical comparisons.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harmonic oscillator wells in Kronig–Penney model permit analytical solutions analogous to the traditional square-well formulation
hypotheses.result: Analytical dispersion and wave functions derived; tight-binding approximation expressions obtained

title: Electric vehicle charging planning in complex systems considering HARL dynamic pricing
task: EV charging infrastructure planning with dynamic pricing in coupled energy-transportation networks
key_results: 14.6% peak load reduction at grid nodes; 200,000+ RMB savings in infrastructure investment; 15% reduction in average EV charging costs
comments: Well-integrated multi-objective framework combining HARL, small-world networks, and NSGA-III, though field validation on real networks is not reported.

model_io.model: HARL-driven dynamic TOU pricing with small-world spatial optimization and NSGA-III
inputs: EV charging demand, electricity price elasticity, network topology
outputs: optimal charging station locations, real-time TOU prices

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic HARL-based pricing outperforms fixed TOU schemes in peak load mitigation and cost reduction

title: TTLD: transformer-based threatening language detection in urdu social media text
task: Threatening language detection in Urdu social media
key_results: F1-score of 90.42% on annotated Urdu tweet dataset; outperformed multilingual, monolingual, and Twitter-specific baselines
comments: Addresses an important low-resource NLP gap, though the dataset size is not disclosed which limits reproducibility assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-adapted embeddings (XLM-T) combined with sequential and attention mechanisms improve threat detection in low-resource settings
hypotheses.result: Achieved superior F1-score versus all baselines tested

title: Earthquake magnitude estimation using an optimized CNN-DNN-GRU model with binary differential evolution and firefly algorithm
task: Earthquake magnitude estimation using optimized CNN-DNN-GRU with metaheuristic feature selection and hyperparameter tuning
key_results: MSE 0.0109, RMSE 0.1048, MAE 0.0837, R² 0.9918 on 3.5M seismic events (1990–2023); BDE feature selection + FA hyperparameter tuning enhance generalization
comments: Strong empirical metrics on large dataset; however, temporal train-test split is not explicitly confirmed, and robustness to class imbalance or regional variation is not discussed.

model_io.model: CNN-DNN-GRU with BDE feature selection and FA hyperparameter tuning
inputs: seismic event parameters: magnitude, depth, geospatial coordinates (3.5M instances, 1990–2023)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synergistic CNN-DNN-GRU architecture capturing spatial, hierarchical, and temporal features, optimized via BDE+FA, achieves superior magnitude estimation
hypotheses.result: R² 0.9918, RMSE 0.1048; reliable for early-warning system integration

title: Prediction-based sign placement using QA sampling
task: Pedestrian flow forecasting and sign placement via quantum annealing-based trajectory sampling
key_results: SQA correctly reproduces congestion patterns; hardware QA exhibits 95% constraint violations despite zero chain-breaks; classical parallel-tempering achieves <1% violation rate
comments: Identifies critical hardware-specific limitations (dynamic range) rather than connectivity failures; post-hoc repair destroys spatial coherence despite numerical RMSE similarity—a sobering lesson for quantum advantage claims.

model_io.model: QUBO trajectory sampler (SQA, D-Wave hardware QA, classical parallel-tempering)
inputs: sparse crowd measurements, periodic headcount transitions
outputs: ensemble of feasible trajectories, probabilistic macroscopic flow forecasts, sign placement recommendations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum annealing as a probabilistic sampler generates diverse trajectories consistent with physical constraints and transition preferences
hypotheses.result: SQA validation successful; hardware QA fails due to dynamic range limits, not formulation deficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increased penalty strengths resolve hardware constraint violations
hypotheses.result: Insufficient; comprehensive penalty landscape recalibration required
